_meta.status: Draft interface copy for the screens in docs/product/screens.md. Approved strings: brand.tagline, language labels, shelf names, event intents, status.onHold. Everything else is working copy.

brand.tagline: Writers find their way. Readers find their writers.

language.changeLater: You can change the language anytime in Settings.

auth.name: Name
auth.readerFirst: Everyone starts as a reader. You can add a writer profile anytime.
auth.verifyBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.
auth.recoverBody: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.recoverySent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent it a link to set a new password.

roles.writerBody: Keep your reader library and add a space for your manuscripts, excerpts and published work.
roles.manuscriptsPrivate: Manuscripts stay private until you choose publishers
roles.roleDisclaimer: A writer profile is a role in Lisette. It doesn't verify your identity or certify authorship.

status.onHoldExplain: The publisher is still considering your submission.
status.selectedExplain: The publisher would like to discuss next steps and will contact you directly.

manuscripts.title: Manuscripts
manuscripts.privacyBanner: Private. Only you and the publishers you choose can open your manuscripts.
manuscripts.validPdf: This file is a valid PDF.
manuscripts.invalidPdf: This file isn't a valid PDF. Lisette accepts PDF manuscripts only.
manuscripts.noEditor: Lisette doesn't edit manuscripts. Make changes in your own editor, then upload the new PDF here.
manuscripts.hashRecord: We record this file's hash and upload time. That's a record of this version, not proof of authorship.
manuscripts.deviceAuthHint: Use your fingerprint or phone PIN.
manuscripts.previewReadOnly: Read-only. This is the version you're about to send.

submit.alreadyActive: Already in review with this work.
submit.sharingAuthorControlled: Sharing: author-controlled. You decide what readers see.
submit.sharingApproval: Sharing: synopsis and excerpt approval. Before readers see a synopsis or excerpt from this work, {{publisher}} approves the exact text.
submit.contactBody: Your email {{email}} and phone {{phone}} will be shared with the publishers you selected so they can contact you directly. They won't appear publicly or be used for marketing.
submit.agreeContact: I agree to share my contact details
submit.declaration: I confirm that I wrote this manuscript, or have permission from all rights holders to submit it and share the selected material.
submit.firstSent: Your first submission is on its way.
submit.didntSendBody: Nothing was sent to {{publisher}}. Your manuscript is still saved.
submit.unknownResult: We couldn't confirm this one. Check your submissions before trying again.

submission.copyImmutable: This copy stays as sent. New versions don't change it.
submission.withdrawExplain: Withdrawing ends {{publisher}}'s access to this submission in Lisette. Copies they already downloaded can't be recalled. Your other submissions aren't affected.

publisher.onHoldHint: Still considering. Reading stays on, download stays off.
publisher.selectHint: You'd like to discuss next steps with the author. Not a contract.
publisher.rejectHint: Final. Your access to this manuscript ends.
publisher.evaluationPrivate: Private to you and the author. Required to select.
publisher.contactDirect: You'll contact {{author}} directly using the email and phone they shared with you.
publisher.downloadOff: Download is off while this submission is on hold. Reading in Lisette stays on.

sharing.approvalRule: Readers see this only after every required approval covers this exact text. If you edit it, approval starts again.
sharing.approveExact: You're approving this exact text. Any edited version needs a new approval.

beta.title: Beta-readers
beta.readOnly: You can read these pages in Lisette. Downloading isn't available.

patterns.title: Reading patterns
patterns.basedOn_one: Based on {{count}} reader who chose to share reading patterns
patterns.basedOn_other: Based on {{count}} readers who chose to share reading patterns
patterns.belowThreshold: Patterns appear once enough readers have chosen to share them.
patterns.notQuality: Patterns, not a measure of quality.
patterns.optInTitle: Share your reading patterns with authors?
patterns.optInBody: If you agree, authors see where readers linger in their excerpts. They never see your name. Choose below how you're included. You can stop anytime in Settings.
patterns.noiseSwitch: Include the noise level around me
patterns.noiseBody: Measured on your phone only. Lisette never records, keeps or sends audio.
patterns.levelStandard: Only together with at least 10 readers
patterns.levelStandardHint: Your patterns count only once 10 or more readers share theirs.
patterns.levelNoThresholdHint: Your patterns can appear even if you're one of very few readers. The author won't see your name, but may be able to tell how you read.

library.title: Library
library.privateBanner: Your library is private. You choose which books appear on your profile.
library.showOnProfileOff: Off. Only you see this book.
library.scanHint: Point the camera at the barcode on the back cover.
library.scanSteady: Hold the book steady, in good light.
library.scanFailed: We couldn't scan that barcode. Try again, or add the book by hand.

events.intentNote: This shows your interest. It isn't a ticket or a booking.

discoveries.label: Literary discovery
discoveries.hiddenUntilHere: The text and images stay hidden until you're here.
discoveries.closeEnough: You're close enough to unlock it.
discoveries.tooFar: You need to be at this place to unlock it.
discoveries.locationOnce: Uses your location once, when you tap. No background tracking.
discoveries.unlocked: Unlocked. It's in your discoveries now, to reopen from anywhere.
discoveries.unavailable: This discovery is no longer available.

notifications.betaInvite: {{author}} shared pages with you as a beta-reader

settings.title: Settings
settings.readingThemeAuto: Adjust to the light around me
settings.appLock: Lock manuscripts with fingerprint or PIN
settings.unblockNote: Unblocking doesn't restore earlier follows or reactions.

errors.network: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.uploadUnknown: We couldn't confirm the upload. Check your manuscripts before trying again.
errors.sendFailed: Your submission didn't send. Your saved manuscript is still available. Try sending it again.
errors.permissionCamera: Lisette needs the camera to scan barcodes. You can still add books by hand.
errors.permissionLocation: Lisette needs your location once to unlock a discovery. You can still browse the map.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password isn’t right.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first. Look for the link in your inbox.
errors.passwordTooShort: Use at least 10 characters for your password.
errors.invalidEmail: This email address doesn’t look right.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
